ledger.why: VV3: the designer's game note (the Tribal Chief only observes; no event replaces or deposes the Chief): nothing in the event casts or changes the Chief, so it holds in every game

collection.description: A council member wonders whether distant communities select leaders by ancestry, skill, election, chance, or force.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A council member wonders whether distant communities select leaders by ancestry, skill, election, chance, or force.

text_only.reason: "experience" in its everyday sense (what a person has lived through), not a skill gain

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Villagers conduct a harmless vote on festival music and discover how difficult counting preferences can be.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The minority dislikes the result; the mediator asks what fair representation requires.

text_only.reason: a feeling in the moment, not a lasting dislike

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder notes that continuity can preserve knowledge and traditions.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A young builder asks what happens when an heir is unwilling or unqualified.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Researchers propose rotating responsibilities among skilled groups.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A sudden disagreement reveals how hard shared leadership can be when decisions are urgent.
